name: rapid-builder
description: HTTP service that builds rapid packages from GitHub PRs/branches and publishes them to Bunny storage

scripts.test:e2e: docker build --target e2e -t rapid-build-e2e . && docker run --rm rapid-build-e2e
scripts.test:e2e-podman: podman build --target e2e -t rapid-build-e2e . && podman run --rm rapid-build-e2e
scripts.check: biome check && tsc && echo 'typecheck ok' && node --test --test-reporter=dot test/*.ts
